# Supervisor Decision and Change Log

> Append decisions and corrections; do not rewrite history. A new entry may supersede an earlier entry but must name it. Raw audio, video, ASR, and machine translation remain unchanged.

## Document metadata

- Project:
- Log owner:
- Log created:
- Current proposal version/link:
- Current master traceability version/link:
- Current three-study contract version/link:
- Current claim register version/link:

## Allowed outcome and confirmation values

- Decision outcome: `Accepted`, `Accepted with changes`, `Rejected`, or `Deferred`.
- Confirmation status: `Draft read-back`, `Sent for confirmation`, `Confirmed`, or `Correction requested`.
- Change state: `Proposed`, `Effective`, `Superseded`, or `Withdrawn`.
- Silence, attendance, receipt of a document, or lack of objection is not acceptance.

### Change-impact checklist

- [ ] Master traceability rows updated.
- [ ] Three-study contract updated if an RQ, study, Plan A/Plan B, method, dataset, gate, or publication target changed.
- [ ] Claim register wording/state updated if evidence strength changed.
- [ ] RACI/resource/RAID ownership and status updated.
- [ ] Proposal and presentation wording updated.
- [ ] Literature matrix/taxonomy updated if scope or contribution changed.
- [ ] Schedule and working-target assumptions updated.
- [ ] Weekly pre-read records the change.
- [ ] Historical source and prior decision remain preserved.

### Decision read-back

> On [date], [approver(s)] [outcome] [exact decision]. [Owner] will deliver [artifact/evidence] by [due date]. The decision is subject to [gates/constraints]. It [does/does not] supersede [prior decision].

## Plan A/Plan B change control

### Automatic fallback record

Complete this on or immediately after the checkpoint.

| Field | Entry |
| --- | --- |
| Checkpoint | 2026-08-26 23:59 Asia/Jerusalem |
| G1–G6 gates with owner, evidence path, and feasible completion date | __ / 6 |
| Failed gate IDs |  |
| Six-gate pass status | __ / 6; all six are mandatory before row-level access |
| Downstream integrity/pilot/export status | Blocked until all six entry gates pass |
| Evidence reviewed |  |
| Result | Plan A verified / Plan B activated automatically |
| Effective date | 2026-08-27 if any gate is unverified |
| Study 3 path | Medical-enabled / Non-medical replication |
| Proposal/schedule changes |  |
| Owner recording result |  |
| Supervisor notification evidence |  |

The Plan B activation is an execution of the pre-agreed risk rule, not a claim that medicine lacks scientific value.

### Plan A reopening after fallback

Plan A may reopen only when all boxes are checked:

- [ ] A1 through A8 are complete with linked evidence.
- [ ] Ethics/privacy/data and infrastructure authorities have approved the exact study.
- [ ] Iris and Arnon record an explicit `Accepted` or `Accepted with changes` decision.
- [ ] Schedule-impact analysis shows how committed Plan B milestones are protected or deliberately changed.
- [ ] Three-study contract, claim register, traceability, and RAID records are updated.
- [ ] No clinical or partner claim is backdated.
